The app icon has been updated. I also copied it to the adaptive icon for Android:

The app icon has been updated across all platforms (iOS icon, Android adaptive icon, and web favicon) with your mountain peak image.

However, **I can't resubmit the build for you** — that falls outside of app development support. To get the new icon included in your App Store build:

1. **Trigger a new build** from the Rork dashboard (look for a "Build" or "Publish" button)
2. Once the new build is ready, go to **App Store Connect**
3. Select the new build under your app version
4. Submit for review again

The new icon will be automatically embedded in the build since it's now set in `assets/images/icon.png`.
